title: Tseitin auxiliary literals
statement: Let $n$, $c$, and $b$ be natural numbers, and let $i$ be a clause index in $	ext{Fin}(c)$. The construction assigns a list of $b$ literals on $n+bc$ coordinates, one for each position $j$ in $	ext{Fin}(b)$. The literal at position $j$ uses coordinate $n+jc+i$ and has required sign $-1$.
